description: Expected results for official USGS PHREEQC example 1 (examples/ex1, 'Add uranium and speciate seawater'), run with the database the example uses (database/phreeqc.dat). Every expected value is copied from the official USGS output examples/ex1.out that ships in the phreeqc3 git tree (commit 311a485); tolerance = one unit in the last digit printed there. In addition run_reference.py compares the whole output to reference/ex1.out line by line (same last-digit rule), skipping only the 3 file-path header lines and the trailing run-time line.
engine_version: PHREEQC 3.8.9 (October 13, 2025 banner), built from usgs-coupled/phreeqc3 git 311a485

numeric_checks.name: pH
numeric_checks.why: input pH kept (charge balance not on pH)

numeric_checks.name: specific_conductance
numeric_checks.why: computed specific conductance, uS/cm at 25 C

numeric_checks.name: total_carbon
numeric_checks.why: total C from alkalinity 141.682 as HCO3

numeric_checks.name: electrical_balance
numeric_checks.why: charge balance of the seawater analysis, eq

numeric_checks.name: molality_UO2(CO3)3-4
numeric_checks.why: main U species (uranyl tricarbonate), read with KI parse tool

numeric_checks.name: molality_HCO3-
numeric_checks.why: main carbon species, read with KI parse tool

numeric_checks.name: n_si_phases
numeric_checks.why: number of phases in the saturation index table

numeric_checks.name: SI_Uraninite
numeric_checks.why: uraninite (the phase added in the input) far undersaturated

extra_checks: return code 0 and 'End of Run after ... Seconds.' line present
whole output equals official reference/ex1.out (except 3 path header lines + run-time line), numbers within 1 unit of last printed digit
recorded_with: /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/PHREEQC/source/repo/build/phreeqc, run directly (KI tools/run_phreeqc.py crashes on phreeqc.dat, see README)
reference: reference/ex1.out = git show 311a485:examples/ex1.out (official USGS expected output)
notes: Two clean runs on 2026-10-05 gave outputs that differ only in the run-time line; apart from the file-path header lines and the run-time line, the run is identical byte for byte to the official ex1.out. Inputs are not changed in any way.
